sources.title: The Meili Snow Mountains: Sacred Yunnan Mountain Range - China Highlights
sources.content:
Meili Snow Mountains: Comprehensive Overview

Basic Information
The Meili Snow Mountains, alternatively called the Prince Snow Mountains, are situated in the Tibetan Plateau foothills approximately 10 kilometers west of Deqin County Town in Yunnan Province. "The most beautiful mountains in the world" is how American scholars characterized them during the 1930s.

Geographic Features
The range contains 13 peaks averaging over 6,000 meters in elevation. The highest peak, Kawagebo, reaches 6,740 meters and remains unclimbed — a virgin summit. The mountains stand roughly 4 hours' drive from Shangri-La.

Primary Activities

Sunrise Viewing: The golden sunrise illuminating the snow-capped peaks is the signature experience. This phenomenon occurs best from October through March during clear, dry conditions. Feilai Temple Viewing Platform (3,470 meters) and Wunongding Viewing Deck (3,500 meters) offer optimal vantage points.

Glacier Exploration: Mingyong Glacier, stretching 11.7 kilometers and measuring 500 meters wide, represents China's lowest-altitude glacier. A 10-kilometer hiking route to the observation deck requires approximately 3 hours.

Mountain Trekking: The Feilai Temple-to-Yubeng Village pilgrimage route has become popular for hikers. Along this path, visitors encounter alpine forests, waterfalls, glacial lakes, and traditional Tibetan settlements.

Yubeng Village Details
This traditional village divides into upper and lower sections, separated by one kilometer, positioned at the mountains' base. Simple hostel accommodations serve visitors.

Best Visiting Seasons
October-November presents ideal conditions for sunrise observation, while December-March offers clear skies despite cold temperatures. July-August should be avoided due to heavy rainfall and mist obscuring views.

Transportation Options
Private transfers from Shangri-La remain recommended, though public buses operate four daily routes covering the six-hour journey to Deqin.

Nearby Attractions
- Benzilan Town (historic Tea-Horse Road stop)
- Jinsha River Big Bend/Moon Bay
- Dongzhulin Monastery (established 1667)
- Baima Snow Mountain (habitat for Yunnan snub-nosed monkeys)

Hiking Considerations
Treks require 2-4 days, reaching altitudes between 3,000-4,500 meters. Altitude sickness preparedness is essential. May-June and September-early November represent optimal trekking seasons.

sources.title: Meili Snow Mountain: Kawagebo, Mingyong Glacier, Weather & Hiking - China Discovery
sources.content:
Meili Snow Mountain: Kawagebo, Mingyong Glacier, Weather & Hiking

Meili Snow Mountain is located in Deqin County in the northwest of Shangri-La, about 176 kilometers away. It is one of the most sacred mountains of Tibetan Buddhism.

The highest peak Kawagebo rises about 6740 meters and is reputed as the most beautiful mountain in the world. It is still a virgin peak as no one has ever reached the top. Meili Snow Mountain has 13 peaks all over 6,000 meters.

Feilai Temple is a small but interesting Tibetan temple located about 5 km southwest of Deqin County Town and is always the first stop for tourists visiting the snow mountains. The viewing platform here offers the classic panoramic view of the mountain range.

The ideal seasons to visit are between October and May, with the best season after the end of October when you can view the main peak because of the nice weather, clean air and high transparency.

It is about 14 kilometers from Deqin County and takes about 0.5 hour's driving, and about 176km and 4 hours from Shangri-La.

sources.title: Meili Snow Mountain: Kawagebo, Mingyong Glaciers, Hiking - ChinaXianTour
sources.content:
Meili Snow Mountain: Kawagebo, Mingyong Glaciers, Hiking

Meili Snow Mountain is one of the most sacred mountains in Tibetan Buddhism, located in Deqin County, Yunnan. The mountain range features 13 peaks above 6,000 meters, with Kawagebo at 6,740 meters being the highest and still unconquered.

The mountain is sacred to Tibetan Buddhists and has been officially closed to climbing since 2001 out of respect for local religious beliefs and after a tragic mountaineering accident in 1991 that killed 17 climbers.

Key attractions include the Feilai Temple viewpoint, Mingyong Glacier (China's lowest-altitude glacier), and Yubeng Village — a remote Tibetan settlement accessible only on foot or by mule.

The Yubeng trek is one of the most popular multi-day hikes in Yunnan, taking visitors through pristine alpine scenery to sacred waterfalls and glacial lakes.

sources.title: Meili Snow Mountain - Shangri La Yunnan China
sources.content:
Meili Snow Mountain - Shangri La Yunnan China

Meili Snow Mountain is a sacred Tibetan Buddhist mountain range in Deqin County, about 4 hours drive from Shangri-La. The range features 13 peaks above 6,000 meters, with Kawagebo (6,740m) being the highest and the only major peak in the world that has never been summited.

The golden sunrise over Kawagebo is one of the most sought-after natural spectacles in Yunnan. Feilai Temple and Wunongding are the best viewpoints. Clear conditions are most common from October through March.

Yubeng Village at the mountain's base is a popular trekking destination. The village is only accessible by a multi-hour hike or mule ride, making it one of the most remote inhabited places in Yunnan.

Mingyong Glacier is another highlight, being one of the lowest-altitude glaciers in the Northern Hemisphere. A hiking trail leads to an observation point overlooking the glacier.

sources.title: 梅里雪山 - 百度百科
sources.content:
梅里雪山综合信息

基本信息
梅里雪山位于云南省迪庆藏族自治州德钦县，属横断山脉——怒山山脉。主峰卡瓦格博，"海拔6740米"，是云南第一高峰。景区面积960平方千米，被列为AAAA级景区。

地理位置
"地处滇、川、藏三省结合部，横断山脉中段怒江与澜沧江之间"。北连西藏阿冬格尼山，南与碧罗雪山相接，是三江并流世界自然遗产腹心地。

气候与环境
属高原性寒温带山地气候，"全年温度较低，干湿季节分明"。1990-2020年多年平均气温6.02℃；平均降水798.95毫米，主要分布在夏季。

冰川资源
梅里有四条大冰川：明永、斯农、纽巴和浓松。明永冰川是"云南省最大、最长和末端海拔最低的山谷冰川"，绵延11.7千米，面积13平方千米。

生物多样性
"梅里雪山是云南生物多样性最丰富的地区之一"，植被分为9种植被型、13亚型、32个群系。物种包括红豆杉、冷杉、黑熊、小熊猫、藏马鸡等。

主要山峰
"太子十三峰"中，卡瓦格博最高；其他著名峰包括吉娃仁安（五冠峰）、缅茨姆峰（神女峰）、狮子座雪山等。

宗教文化
藏传佛教认为卡瓦格博是"胜乐宝轮圣山极乐世界的象征"。卡瓦格博是"至今仍未被世人征服的处女峰，也是唯一一座因文化保护而禁止攀登的高峰"。

旅游景区
景区由五大板块构成：金沙江大湾（月亮湾）、雾浓顶迎宾台、飞来寺观景台、雨崩景区、明永冰川。雨崩被誉为"世外桃园""徒步者的天堂"。

旅游信息
开放时间08:00-16:30。可从香格里拉、丽江或西藏、四川进入德钦县。外转经路线需10-15天，是全球精品生态线路之一。

sources.title: Diqing Meili Snow Mountain Travel - Yunnan Exploration
sources.content:
Diqing Meili Snow Mountain Travel Guide

Meili Snow Mountain is a sacred mountain range in Deqin County, about 176 km northwest of Shangri-La. The range features 13 peaks above 6,000 meters, with Kawagebo (6,740m) being the highest unclimbed peak in the world.

The mountain is one of the eight sacred mountains of Tibetan Buddhism. The annual pilgrimage circuit (outer kora) attracts thousands of Tibetan pilgrims, especially during the Year of the Sheep in the Tibetan calendar.

Key viewing spots include Feilai Temple (5 km from Deqin) and Wunongding, both offering panoramic views of the mountain range. The golden sunrise on Kawagebo is the most iconic sight.

Yubeng Village, accessible only on foot, is a popular trekking destination at the base of the mountains. The trek typically takes 2-3 days and passes through pristine alpine scenery.
